title: @bsh/degent-market environment
description: Environment variables read by src/config.ts. No secrets: the service holds no keys. Variables marked x-required-unless-regtest may be omitted only when NETWORK=regtest.

NETWORK.description: Bitcoin network. Dev adapters (in-memory store, MEMBERSHIP=memory) are refused off regtest.

DATABASE_PATH.description: node:sqlite database file (listings, buy sessions, SIWB nonces).

BUYS_ENABLED.description: Kill switch. false: /v1/buy/* answers 503 buys_paused and the UI shows the paused banner. Owner decision; see docs/SETTLEMENT.md section 7 before setting true.

ROYALTY_BPS.description: Royalty on every sale, basis points 0..5000, paid by the buyer on top of the price to TREASURY_ADDRESS. Owner decision.

TREASURY_ADDRESS.description: Receives the royalty output (required when ROYALTY_BPS > 0; must be on NETWORK). Owner decision.

DUMMY_VALUE_SATS.description: Value of each padding UTXO the dummy round creates (600..1000).

PENDING_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Re-open a pending listing when its broadcast purchase never appears.

UTXO_SAFETY_CHECK.description: Ask ord whether each buyer UTXO carries an inscription before spending it. false is refused on mainnet with buys enabled.

ESPLORA_URL.description: esplora / mempool.space API base (default per network).

MEMBERSHIP.description: Collection membership source. Default: memory on regtest, mint-register otherwise.

MINT_API_URL.description: degent-mint base URL (Register API) when MEMBERSHIP=mint-register.

ROSTER_FILE.description: Roster JSON ({ members: [{ n, inscriptionId }] }) when MEMBERSHIP=roster.

PARENT_INSCRIPTION_ID.description: Club parent; children of it count as Degents when MEMBERSHIP=roster.

SIWB_DOMAIN.description: Domain in SIWB challenges (default market.degent.club; 127.0.0.1:8788 on regtest).

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated exact origins. Empty = deny cross-origin browser calls.
